thumb_rules.description: thumb tips must extend this fraction of palm width past IP joint to count as thumb_up or thumbs_down

orientation_rules.description: tip-to-mcp distance / palm_diagonal ratio above which a finger counts as 'extended'; also the open/pinch detection threshold

orientation_rules_2.description: cross-product z-value above which palm is 'UP', below which it is 'DOWN'

fist_rules.description: pixel-based spread limit for 'closed fist' detection; below = closed, above = open

position_rules.description: normalized x-center thresholds for left/right palm detection
